description: Get federal government contract awards won by a specific public company: US federal awards (from USAspending.gov) or Government of Canada contracts (from its proactive publication of contracts over C$10,000). Shows the award (action) date, recipient named by the government, awarding agency or department, total value (US: obligated dollars plus unexercised ceiling; Canada: contract value including amendments, in Canadian dollars; never revenue received), outlays when reported, end date, and description. Coverage: US prime contract awards of $1M or more, and Canadian contracts reported from fiscal 2017-2018 (April 2017) whose vendor name exactly matches a company listed on a Canadian exchange, so sums understate government revenue. Use GetTopGovernmentContractors to rank companies market-wide.

agency.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on the awarding agency (e.g., 'Defense')

country.description: Awarding government: US or CA. Defaults to the country of the listing the symbol names (CA for XTSE:CAE, US for a bare US ticker)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of awards to return (default: 50)

offset.description: Number of matching awards to skip before returning rows (default: 0)

sortBy.description: Sort order: 'amount' (largest total value first, default) or 'date' (most recent award first)

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, filtering on the award action date (defaults to 1 year ago)

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., LMT, RTX, BA), or MIC:TICKER for a Canadian listing (e.g., XTSE:CAE)

name: GetGovernmentContracts
title: Federal Contracts by Company
